account_destination: User's signed-in Codex account Controller via the existing pinned local CodexCLI

payload.scope: Compact private Train-derived aggregate scores, reviewed history, memory, branch information and relevant research/harness interface/source-hash evidence

source_review.component: One bounded original R/H/C proposal transaction
source_review.author: User-directed Supervisor bootstrap; not Controller self-evolution
source_review.ready_gate: PASS: frozen worker source/test/log and recorded transaction result supplied before final review
verified: Exact grant, current packet authority, source, CLI, input, model, destination and clock before reservation/process
Permanent original root and serial lock; claim/input/schema before original transport
Two-decision cap and no pending-reservation retry
Completed-original recovery reconciles existing reservation only
No automatic activation of R/H/C proposal text and no evidence-session attachment

closed_boundaries: Account tools, file and network actions by Controller
claim_limits: No model call, real Train fit or live ledger mutation performed by reviewer
Tool-event absence is not hard tool or arbitrary-code containment
Hashes establish integrity, not semantic acceptance or reviewer authorship
Source completion is H engineering, not C prediction gain or R self-improvement
R/H proposals require later independent source and downstream-result evidence
Repeated historical Train is Discovery, not untouched OOS; one trajectory cannot establish same-budget mechanism superiority
operation_scope: Exact first compact-input original transaction only; no automatic retry. Existing explicit grant supplies authority, not this review.
next_gate: A changed second feedback-dependent packet requires fresh exact prelaunch review; actual scientific proposal/source/result review remains pending.
